measurement_conditions_frozen.reporting_obligation: ALL 9 specs reported with full metrics regardless of outcome. Failures reported verbatim. Every reported number carries metric_type label.

specs.name: Foreign 60d crowding reversal (single)
specs.pit_lag: investor flow Date < sig_date (t-1, C10); Size normalization t-1
specs.direction_rationale: Foreign 60d accumulation = price-pressure crowding; subsequent unwind underperforms (Choe-Kho-Stulz 2005; KR-validated direction, WT-D20260529_001 OOS).

specs.name: Institutional 60d crowding reversal (single)
specs.pit_lag: investor flow Date < sig_date (t-1, C10); Size normalization t-1
specs.direction_rationale: Institutional herding at 60d horizon mirrors foreign crowding; reversal direction per same KR price-pressure framework (Gompers-Metrick mechanism reversed in KR liquid universe).

specs.name: Retail-follow (KR reversal of Barber-Odean)
specs.formula: score = -1 * Z(-frollsum(Individual,20d)/Size) [= long stocks retail is net-BUYING]
specs.direction_rationale: In KR liquid universe retail is the counterparty absorbing institutional/foreign unwind; contrarian-to-flow framework implies retail-follow (KR mechanism reversal of classic fade-retail; consistent with WT-D20260529_001 composite which negated INV07 uniformly).

specs.name: Incumbent contrarian composite — Stage A standard re-measurement
specs.formula: score = -1 * mean(Z_f for f in 5 factors, na.rm), then cross-sectional re-z per Date
specs.pit_lag: all components investor flow Date < sig_date (t-1, C10)
specs.direction_rationale: Forge-validated incumbent (PORT_t 2.35 backtested, quarterly/buffer/top-20) re-measured under Stage A frozen conditions (monthly top-25 EW, 2005-01~, delta cost) as the family baseline. Within-FLOW-family combination — charter additive-Z ban applies to cross-family composites only.
specs.charter_compliance_note: FLOW family internal combination; no cross-family Z averaging.

specs.name: Smart-money participation imbalance reversal
specs.direction_rationale: Volume-normalized (foreign+inst) net participation = crowding intensity scale-free of market cap; reversal per same framework. Prior diagnostics flagged INV10 as strongest single (ICIR 0.291) — never measured standalone at portfolio level.

specs.name: Foreign flow acceleration continuation (short-horizon)
specs.direction_rationale: Distinct mechanism axis from S01: 20d-vs-60d ACCELERATION proxies new information arrival -> short-horizon continuation precedes long-horizon price-pressure reversal (horizon-structure hypothesis; only continuation-direction spec in this prereg).

specs.name: Foreign residual flow (orthogonal to retail mirror) reversal
specs.formula: score = -1 * Z(z_F_63d - beta_t * z_I_63d), beta_t = expanding no-intercept OLS (lag 1, burn-in 60m)
specs.pit_lag: investor flow Date < sig_date (t-1, C10); beta_t expanding-window lag-1 (C1)
specs.direction_rationale: Removes the mechanical retail-mirror component from foreign flow; tests whether the crowding-reversal edge survives orthogonalization (pure foreign price-pressure axis, Choe-Kho-Stulz 2005). Coverage 2005-02~ (one month short of window start — reported as-is).

specs.name: Foreign-institutional agreement reversal
specs.direction_rationale: Simultaneous foreign AND institutional net buying = maximum-consensus crowding; framework predicts strongest subsequent unwind when both informed classes are positioned the same way.

specs.name: Flow persistence reversal (single)
specs.formula: score = -1 * Z(fraction of last 20 days with F+I > 0)
specs.direction_rationale: Persistence (breadth-in-time) vs magnitude (S01/S02) is a distinct construction axis: sustained multi-day accumulation = sustained price pressure -> reversal (KR reversal of Yan-Zhang 2009 persistence-continuation).
